verdict.rationale: The evidence documents POS UI extensions that add custom tiles, modals, and blocks inside the Shopify POS app, and those extensions can call the Admin API. That is client-side customization running in the app. Nothing shows a server-driven API that lets a developer's backend push checkouts or payments to the terminal, so the story is not supported.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a custom point-of-sale checkout that drives the terminal from my backend through a documented server-driven API
